scope: Disjoint unchanged original GNU Tar selections on identical candidate bytes. All selected assertions pass, and every recorded candidate process log is hash-verified and reparsed. Original native findings remain unchanged. These are reviewed selections, not full-provider certification.

Test helpers are native dependencies, not ports.
